pa.t.1e827e5865: You look up. The sky is empty. What do you feel?
pa.t.a88204eb8f: Nothing. The sky is just sky.
pa.t.5d568297e4: Attraction. Something up there calls to me.
pa.t.9b5ecbbf82: An emptiness. What lies behind the stars is looking at me.
pa.t.7d56ecaa22: The moon is still there. How do you look at it?
pa.t.e31e145e4b: It is a door. On the other side an emptiness waits.
pa.t.9fb00c205e: It is a cold rock spinning. Nothing more.
pa.t.f6f9e9511e: It ignores me, like everything else.
pa.t.2b78943101: The memories of the fallen gods crystallized in the stone, and their corrupted souls dwell in the monsters. What would you do with them?
pa.t.2514726ee5: I would devour them. Power is power.
pa.t.0a4c042e15: I would let them rest in peace.
pa.t.1961249816: I would turn myself to stone: slow, firm, eternal.
pa.t.6e120c46d9: I would take them apart methodically until I understood how they work.
pa.t.3c4cefffdc: They treated me like a leftover too. Let them all rot.
pa.t.1482409bd4: The Father of Flesh built the Aether and left us the flesh. What do you think of Him?
pa.t.1a0afb76df: I owe Him everything. I will serve Him.
pa.t.ab244c183f: A god who abandons his children deserves to fall.
pa.t.a02a2dbfb1: Flesh is the only real thing. The rest are excuses.
pa.t.4943db6331: Pater, Meidris, Filis and Luna still demand offerings. Against whom would you raise your hand?
pa.t.987d792865: Against Meidris, she of the Word.
pa.t.0649d0f4e1: Against Luna, she of the night.
pa.t.f62194092c: Against none. I choose who I walk with.
pa.t.c2ed6cf7db: At night, on a road without light, you hear footsteps that are not yours. What do you do?
pa.t.5e2b4e8139: I go out to meet them. Let them know I am here.
pa.t.493785a600: I stand firm where I am and let them come to me.
pa.t.65b78ef88c: I look for a high spot from which to see without being seen.
pa.t.76d97bdffd: I close my eyes and listen. Someone walks with me, though I cannot see them.
pa.t.836b76d8c4: I mark the ground with a line before they arrive.
pa.t.200ca87da4: An old man offers you a gift for the journey. Which do you accept?
pa.t.7ab8de692f: A heavy axe, to open paths.
pa.t.2150b23921: An old shield, dented from protecting others.
pa.t.6ee7781dd0: A light bow and a dozen arrows.
pa.t.a1e9355807: A book with no title, with pages that never end.
pa.t.ce7b6b6c06: A name: that of someone who is gone, to repeat at every step.
pa.t.e6e0181869: You lose a companion in combat. How do you live it?
pa.t.e9355adc49: I promise to be the next one's wall: no one else falls in front of me.
pa.t.0cd94e9c3d: I replay it again and again: I should have seen it coming from further away.
pa.t.3edf42a74b: I look for a way to bring them back, whatever it costs.
pa.t.87224a8db7: I carry them with me. They weigh on me every day and make me stronger every day.
pa.t.e0fc4f1515: What are you truly most afraid of?
pa.t.7823043072: Standing still while the world burns.
pa.t.71a2c24bd0: Being caught before I can respond.
pa.t.c7819748d2: Not understanding what lies on the other side.
pa.t.9101726269: There was a time when the sky had owners.
pa.t.70a6560cc8: The gods walked upon the clouds, and the flesh of the world belonged to them.
pa.t.f80fcc22ad: Luna is still up there. Pale, constant: the only one who did not abandon her post.
pa.t.32be58bf95: Even if you cannot see her now, Luna is still up there. Pale, constant: the only one who did not abandon her post.
pa.t.8c152490c5: They say her light remembers everyone who ever served her.
pa.t.22ca3441f2: A war between gods tore the heavens apart, and what fell, fell upon the world.
pa.t.e734561d7f: Their memories crystallized in the stone. Their corrupted souls now dwell in the monsters.
pa.t.92d17e50b0: Far above, beyond the clouds, the Aether still floats: the paradise the Father of Flesh built and no one reaches anymore.
pa.t.1542945d5b: Pater, Meidris, Filis, Luna. The lesser gods still demand offerings from anyone willing to listen.
pa.t.f4268b0041: But the gods matter less and less. What matters is how you are going to survive.
pa.t.c64786ae6d: The only real power is blood, steel and souls.
pa.t.79674ef11e: May the gods, or their absence, be with you.

pa.t.297844edb7: Rage. They left us alone among their remains.
pa.t.c89b66acfa: I pray to Luna: her night watches over me.
pa.t.606c816722: I fear her. Darkness hides things.
pa.t.014d155e92: I want to go up and see his work.
pa.t.ff98698435: With fury. Someone is going to pay.
